== History ==
Founded by [[bpx]] in 2024, the BPX Foundation is a nonprofit dedicated to promote and growing e-sports by supporting teams, organizing tournaments, and fostering talents.

Some of its initiatives include tournaments of Quake Champions (e.g. BPX Cup in Nov/2024 and and BPX Challenge in Dec/2025), besides supporting the team [[Psycose]] and various players with computer gaming peripherals.
